content.en_US: Tritium is a type of heavy [[hydrogen|Hydrogen]], created out of [[lithium|Lithium]] through irradiation. This can be done either in a [[ZIRNOX]], an [[RBMK irradiation channel|RBMK Irradiation Channel]] or a [[fusion reactor breeding chamber|Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber]]. It is mainly used as fuel for the [[fusion reactor|Fusion Reactor]].
